coverage: 2026: 9 football leagues and Formula 1. Published schedules for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UEFA Champions League, PGA Tour, UFC, NASCAR Cup, IndyCar from official league feeds and ESPN, checked weekly. Reviewed event dates: 1 selected boxing unification, 4 men's golf majors, 5 women's golf majors, 13 World Climbing stops, 1 IWF Worlds span, 26 selected LPGA Tour final dates, 16 ONE Fight Night/Samurai cards, 16 PFL global cards, 9 RIZIN cards. See coverage details for inclusions and omissions. No live scores. Football league kickoff times are withheld because the JSON does not explicitly declare their timezone. F1 times use the source's UTC fields.

exclusions: World Climbing: senior Series stops only; no youth, para, continental, Games or invented 2026 senior World Championship.
World Climbing: no individual qualification/final/relay session clocks or estimated durations; the Guiyang round-date disagreement does not change the published September 11–13 stop span.
NASCAR: 36 numbered Cup points races only; Cook Out Clash, the grouped Daytona Duel row and All-Star Race are excluded, along with support series, practice and qualifying.
IndyCar: 18 championship races only; practice, qualifying, warmup and support series are excluded.
All entries are date-only. ET table clocks are omitted because broadcast/start semantics were not established. No midnight or guessed time is generated.
This is a reviewed 2026 snapshot, not a live schedule or a commitment to 2027 coverage. Event titles and future dates may change.
